rules: Provisioning is explicit and create-once; claim/status never provision or repair missing/corrupt state.
All worktrees under the same configured Windows user environment resolve one OS-known fixed location, independent of cwd, repository or LOCALAPPDATA environment overrides.
Provisioning creates an opaque random execution_environment_id; future signed execution scope must bind it. It is not a hostname or hardware attestation.
Authority privately binds the normalized store location hash; moved/copied state at another location fails closed.
Lock each existing directory component with Windows handles that omit FILE_SHARE_DELETE and open reparse points themselves; reject link/reparse components.
Claim creation is atomic create-exclusive; any existing entry, including empty, partial or malformed files, blocks replay without reading its contents.
Once a claim file is created, it is never removed or released on write/flush/close failure, timeout, success or outcome_unknown.
Receipt writes are bounded, flushed with fsync and closed; any uncertainty prevents continuation. No retry/resume/fallback is authorized.
The barrier requires an intact protected store. Rollback, administrative tampering, cloning and power-loss behavior are not independently proved.
Other users/hosts are outside this authorization scope. Store identity must be checked against signed scope before any Provider action.
Local reservation is not source/review/first-live admission or Provider authorization; public timed execution remains closed until full integration.
